title: Underlying abelian colimit of constant-ring module sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], Λ a commutative ring in Type(u+1), A a small category in Type(u+1), D a diagram of Λ-module sheaves on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and c a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then the image of c under sheafCompose with the forgetful functor ModuleCat Λ → AddCommGrpCat is a colimit cocone of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. No finiteness, filteredness, or qcqs assumption is needed.

proof.text: Form presheaf colimits sectionwise. Forgetting module structures preserves them, by the universal property of colimits of modules and abelian groups. Sheafify; module and abelian sheafification have the same underlying abelian sheaves. Transfer the resulting abelian colimit property to the given cocone along its canonical module-colimit isomorphism.

theorem moduleSheaf_underlying_isColimit
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory A]
    {D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    {c : Cocone D} (hc : IsColimit c) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).mapCocone c))
